key_idea: After unfolding, every hole has a twin on the other side of the fold, like in a mirror.
steps: The fold is the brown edge on the left. After unfolding, it is the line in the middle.
The square is at the top, far from the fold. So there are 2 squares at the top, near the outside edges.
The circle is lower, close to the fold. So there are 2 circles lower down, close to the middle line.

choice_feedback.A: This shows only one half. After unfolding there are 2 squares and 2 circles.
choice_feedback.C: Here the circles and squares have swapped places. The squares should be at the top.
choice_feedback.D: There are no squares here, but a square hole was punched.
choice_feedback.E: There is only 1 circle here. There should be 2, one on each side of the middle line.
